notes.title: v0.13.08 - Loc fix
notes.content: Should be a fix for a new issue where the localization system we've been building in the background was activated by mistake! English should be forced on by now.

notes.title: SCAN, SOLVE, SURVIVE Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Story: There are now many bizarre objects scattered across the world. Together they hint at how to escape, if you can piece it all together
[*] Scanning: Interact with these objects by using your scanner. Scanned Objects are added to the clues screen where you can piece together their meaning
[*] Entity Compendium: Scan enemies to learn more about their quirks, and how to avoid them
[*] Bonus Tasks: Each round you’re given 3 random tasks that you can choose to complete for extra rewards
[/list]

[b]Improvements and Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Single Player now has a prompt to Save Game after a round
[*] Single Player save data doesn’t delete itself when failing
[*] Emotes are now in a Radial Menu (Press TAB to display/hide)
[*] Improved platforming
[*] Dismiss controls on UI while in Menus
[*] ADVANCE button is now NEXT
[*] Flare gun now properly kills players
[*] Cursors on screens are now synced in multiplayer
[*] Load Level Selection has a header during the intro
[*] Wall Monsters now have an idle audio
[*] Room Code font changed to be more readable
[*] Fixed issues where abducted players were not appearing properly on the minimap
[*] Fixed an issue where if a player had an item equipped when the level was unloaded, that item would sometimes be invisible in their hands when a new level is loaded
[/list]

notes.title: v0.9.01
notes.content: To address new performance spikes after upgrading to unity 6, we had to temporarily yank D3D12 support, which means no more raytracing and motion blur. Our hope is to add these options back in the future, but for now, performance spikes and crashing should be a thing of the past.

notes.title: v0.9.00 - engine upgrade
notes.content: To address reports of crashing (particularly while streaming) we were ultimately forced to do a complete engine upgrade to Unity 6. After stress testing, that appears to have fixed the issue. However, it has also introduced a few framerate hiccups. we will address this immediately.
